correctness.rationale: The finite Hom cell action is free because a nontrivial pentagon rotation forces all colour sets equal and every reflection identifies one adjacent pair. The established reflection-equivariant SO(3) homeomorphism makes a lifted reflection square to the central deck involution; the order-20 covering group is then C5 semidirect C4 with inversion, namely Dic5. Its abelianization, orientability and three-manifold Poincare duality imply exactly the stated homology. An exhaustive independent oriented quotient CW enumeration produced 216 cell orbits and Smith invariants d1=1^23, d2=1^54 plus 4, d3=1^29, corroborating all integral homology groups. The proof establishes the fundamental group without assuming a full-D5 equivariant Stiefel model.

value.rationale: The chosen quotient is the first nontrivial orientable three-manifold instance of the canonical five-cycle colouring construction and directly concerns Dover-Ozaydin Question 5.6. The full nonabelian order-twenty fundamental group and its Z/4 abelianization provide precise invariants of this natural symmetry quotient, meaningful for comparisons with hypothetical full-D5 Stiefel models. The finding is not the already known RP3 identification or a Betti-number recomputation; it is bounded to one natural three-manifold and makes no larger conjectural claim.
